summary: A constant selected-three-eigenspace Pluecker minor need not survive as a nondegenerate physical principal minor or rank-two cross block after the orthogonal spectral complement is restored. Exact target-class stress: A=I_4-J_4/3 has spectrum {1,1,1,-1/3}; the selected eigenvalue-1 subspace has all four triple Pluecker weights 1/4, yet all physical 3x3 principal determinants and all 2+2 cross determinants vanish. This does not refute QFORM.
